# dokploy_notification (Data Source)

Fetches a single notification configuration from Dokploy by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```hcl
# Look up notification by ID
data "dokploy_notification" "by_id" {
  notification_id = "abc123"
}

# Look up notification by name
data "dokploy_notification" "by_name" {
  name = "deploy-alerts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The notification name to look up. Mutually exclusive with notification_id.
- `notification_id` (String) The notification ID to look up. Mutually exclusive with name.

### Read-Only

- `app_build_error` (Boolean) Whether to notify on app build errors.
- `app_deploy` (Boolean) Whether to notify on app deployment.
- `database_backup` (Boolean) Whether to notify on database backup.
- `docker_cleanup` (Boolean) Whether to notify on Docker cleanup.
- `dokploy_restart` (Boolean) Whether to notify on Dokploy restart.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the notification.
- `notification_type` (String) The type of notification (slack, discord, telegram, email).
